narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Put the nine at the end of both numbers, so they get the most.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A nine in the ones place adds nine, but a nine at the left adds nine lakh.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The left places matter more, so the slip is struck out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble appears with nine at the end; 9 and 9,00,000 are compared; the slip is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Big digits in high places make a large number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>For a small difference, make one number small and the other large.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Each card can be used twice.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words high places, big digits appear; the words small top, large bottom appear; the words two of each appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip puts the big digits at the right end. The right places are the smallest places, so they add very little.
